english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a preconceived view or fixed opinion formed before judging the facts.
Use this when the assumption is a preconceived or prejudiced belief, especially about a person.
Use this when stressing an opinion formed beforehand and resistant to the facts.

examples.english: Don't form a preconception so quickly; hear both sides first.
examples.traditional: 唔好咁快有成見，要聽晒雙方講法先。
examples.jyutping: m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 jau5 sing4 gin3 jiu3 teng1 saai3 soeng1 fong1 gong2 faat3 sin1

examples.english: Don’t make an assumption about the newcomer; give them a chance.
examples.traditional: 唔好對新人有成見，畀佢一次機會啦。
examples.jyutping: m4 hou2 deoi3 san1 jan4 jau5 sing4 gin3 bei2 keoi5 jat1 ci3 gei1 wui6 laa1

examples.english: I used to have deep prejudice against vocational-school students, but later realized I was wrong.
examples.traditional: 我以前對讀職業學校嘅人成見好深，後來先知自己錯。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 cin4 deoi3 duk6 zik1 jip6 hok6 haau6 ge3 jan4 sing4 gin3 hou2 sam1 hau6 loi4 sin1 zi1 zi6 gei2 co3
